headline: TT Limited approves financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026
hook: Standalone and consolidated results for the quarter
summary: TT Limited announced that its Board of Directors met on October 31, 2026, to consider and approve the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company submitted this outcome to the stock exchange as part of its routine regulatory disclosure. Investors review these financial figures to assess the company's operational performance during the period. Detailed financials help retail shareholders gauge earnings growth and profitability trends.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data guides retail assessment of company profitability.

headline: T T Limited announces a change in its board of directors
hook: Leadership shift at a listed textile maker
summary: T T Limited has formally notified the stock exchange about a change in its board of directors. The filing pertains to routine corporate governance and management restructuring at the company. No financial impact or strategic shift was detailed in the brief disclosure. Retail investors should note this is standard administrative churn unless it involves key executive personnel.
why_it_matters: Routine board changes have negligible impact on your holdings.
